public_rationale: Zitron reports his own search: he doesn't 'see much evidence' of custom integrations that 'actually matter', or 'real examples' of businesses using Claude beyond 'vague partnerships'. Nobody can check what he saw. Turning it into the objective claim 'no such examples exist' would change his words. Even that version turns on his own undefined tests of 'real' and 'matter'. Some concrete public accounts did exist before the post. For example, American Banker described Goldman Sachs' Claude agents reviewing documents and making KYC decisions. But the same report says many projects were still proofs of concept, and he dismissed the Goldman example as vague in this very post. Whether such accounts meet his bar is a judgment call, not a checkable fact. So the claim is not adjudicable.
limitations: Only one dated public deployment account was examined; Anthropic's customer-story library was not checked item by item for pre-post dates.
The context items are illustrative and do not test his perception.
